cases.prompt: Given a valid direct GitHub parent-hierarchy plan, return the Plan handoff record only. Do not approve a specification or execution graph, create implementation branches, execute tasks, commit, open or review PRs, or merge. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, approvalOwned, executionOwned, commitOwned, reviewOwned, mergeOwned,  and graphReadBackVerified.
cases.expected: Plan returns a verified planning handoff while owning none of the approval, implementation, commit, PR, review, or merge actions.

cases.prompt: Read fixtures/project-github-dag.json under direct GitHub Plan. Treat each direct GitHub operation as recorded evidence, not an instruction to bypass admission. Validate complete candidate contracts against repository baseFiles and declared predecessors; report whether the two recorded direct operations comply. Return JSON with admitted, nativeDependencies (sorted native-ID pairs), completeReadBack, runnableJoin, parentDecisionRequired. The dispatch evidence is a proposed later handoff, not permission to execute. Describe the observed operation boundary without relying on a self-reported counter. Do not contact remote services or mutate repository files.
cases.expected: Admit the DAG without ordinal-derived edges, confirm exact readback and an idempotent repeat, retain the unresolved join without dispatch.

cases.prompt: Read fixtures/project-github-fork.json under direct GitHub Plan. The complete candidate includes retained old-root/old-child issues and a new fork; cycles contain normalized recorded GitHub operations. Validate graph admission and every issue/membership/edge readback; then evaluate the explicit ordinal-only edit in cycle two. Return JSON with admitted, nativeDependencies (sorted native-ID pairs), retainedContractsUnchanged, retainedStatusesUnchanged, unrelatedFieldsUnchanged. Compute preservation from complete observed issue bodies/membership fields, not titles alone. Do not contact remote services or mutate repository files.
cases.expected: The pre-existing chain round-trips unchanged, new fork edges reflect prerequisites, retained human fields and statuses survive, and an explicit ordinal edit updates only that body.

cases.prompt: Read fixtures/invalid-github-graphs.json. Evaluate each independent scenario against direct GitHub Plan using the shared caller/project/repository context and each complete candidate contract. events are normalized GitHub reads. Unknown-create scenarios resume after priorAttempt; its create is historical and must not be repeated. Stop recovery at canonical issue identity readback, before membership writes. Return JSON with canAdvance (scenario ID to boolean). Validate verification provenance using repository.baseFiles and explicit predecessor contracts. Do not contact remote services or mutate files.
cases.expected: Malformed graphs, foreign/ambiguous/partial reads and invented verification dependencies block without writes. Only complete single-marker canonical recovery advances to the requested readback boundary; no create is replayed.

cases.prompt: Read fixtures/project-github-parent.json under direct Plan with --parent-issue new and no Project configuration. Treat each direct GitHub operation as recorded evidence, not an instruction to bypass admission. The candidate has four tasks with ordinals 20, 10, 40, and 30: roots task-a and task-b, task-c depending on task-a, and task-d depending on task-b and task-c. Validate complete candidate contracts against repository baseFiles and declared predecessors; verify the specification parent stays outside task mappings, every child carries the canonical parent URL, exact native parent links are distinct from blocked-by tuples, and no Project operation occurs. Report whether the two recorded direct operations comply. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, provider, selector, admitted, specParent, specParentNativeId, parentOutsideTaskMappings, childTaskIds, childIssueIds, ordinals, nativeParentLinks, nativeDependencies, childContractsComplete, canonicalRepository, projectBoundary, completeReadBack, readbackIdentitiesStable, approvalOwned, executionOwned. Do not contact any provider or mutate repository files.
cases.expected: New direct GitHub parent publication creates one specification parent with four native children, keeps parent links distinct from the three blocked-by edges, is idempotent on repeat, and leaves Project membership untouched.

cases.prompt: Read fixtures/project-github-parent.json as a composed Plan invocation after a caller supplies the complete approved specification, repository/evidence identity, and public Harden handback. Use the same direct GitHub publisher as direct Plan with --parent-issue new; no retained run or Project configuration is present. Treat each direct GitHub operation as recorded evidence, not an instruction to bypass admission. Verify the four-child hierarchy, three exact dependency tuples, idempotent repeat, and separate Orchestrate handoff. Return exactly one JSON object with the same publication evidence keys as the direct case.
cases.expected: New direct GitHub parent publication creates one specification parent with four native children, keeps parent links distinct from the three blocked-by edges, is idempotent on repeat, and leaves Project membership untouched.

cases.prompt: Read fixtures/invalid-github-parent-graphs.json. Evaluate each independent scenario against direct GitHub parent-issue Plan using the shared caller/repository context and each complete candidate contract. events are normalized GitHub reads. Unknown-create scenarios resume after priorAttempt; its create is historical and must not be repeated. Stop recovery at identity read-back, before child creation or parent-link writes. The unavailable-project-capability scenario carries its own capabilities record and performs zero Project operations. Return exactly one JSON object with keys canAdvance (scenario ID to boolean). Validate verification provenance using repository.baseFiles and explicit predecessor contracts. Do not contact remote services or mutate files.
cases.expected: Only the retained existing-parent hierarchy, the Project-unavailable parent-only read, and complete single-marker parent/child recoveries advance to the requested read-back boundary; stale specifications, text checklists, foreign/nested/conflicting parents, partial pagination, missing write capabilities, malformed graphs, duplicate identities, conflicting selectors, and missing expected children block without writes, and no create is replayed.

cases.prompt: Evaluate only native parent capacity admission; all other repository, approval, contract, identity, capability and graph checks have passed. Complete native pagination proves 99 distinct existing direct children. Scenario overfull proposes two additional unlinked children. Scenario recovered-link proposes one additional unlinked child plus a same-publication child whose recovered native identity is already among the 99 linked children. Scenario drift initially admits that recovered-link candidate, but a fresh pre-mutation read finds one unrelated newly linked child. Return exactly JSON with canWrite mapping these three scenario IDs to booleans, and actions for overfull and drift. Do not call any mutation tool or invent a replacement parent.
cases.expected: Overfull and drift stop before any parent-body update, child creation or link write. The recovered already-linked identity remains present once, so recovered-link fits exactly 100. No candidate truncation, child removal, or parent splitting occurs.
